name: Benfluorex

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in European Union, first in 2009 — for breathing problems and heart harm

similar.name: Dexfenfluramine
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 10 other countries, first in 1997 — for breathing problems and heart harm

similar.name: Prenylamine
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1989 — for heart harm

similar.name: Dilevalol
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1990 — for liver harm

summary: Benfluorex was pulled from the market in the European Union starting in 2009 because of harm to the heart and breathing system [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores of 27 for liver harm and 42 for heart harm [M]. Similar drugs have also been taken off the market, such as Dexfenfluramine for heart and breathing harm, Prenylamine for heart harm, and Dilevalol for liver harm [4][5][6].
